comment: What must not silently disappear from local-dev. `prose` names guardrails no code enforces; `split` declares which half of the skill is deterministic; `baseline` names the offline, $0 checks pinned against a real run.

prose.pattern: Keep planning, review, implementation and testing local unti
prose.rationale: The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extra steps.

prose.pattern: Never claim a result you did not observe
prose.rationale: Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing.

prose.pattern: never ask about anything in the inspection that already answers the question
prose.rationale: Use local evidence before asking the user for information the checkout already supplies.

prose.pattern: commit the reviewed plan before implementation
prose.rationale: Keep the reviewed implementation intent in a separate predecessor commit.
One independent local plan red team replaces remote stage review loops.

nondeterministic.step: Clarify intent, design and red-team the plan, implement and evaluate behavior
nondeterministic.why: Acceptance criteria, design tradeoffs and correctness need repository evidence and user intent.

_baseline_comment: Pinned against a real run of this skill, never a synthetic fixture. Offline and $0 by construction: no network, no model, so CI cannot spend and cannot flake.

baseline.update_command: node ../../../skillfactory/skills/skillfactory/scripts/skillfactory.js freeze --repo ../../../.. --skill local-dev --from /tmp/local-dev-reviewed-run --label local-dev-inspection --command 'node scripts/local-dev.js report --input evals/real-inspection.json --out "$OUT"' --trap-command 'node scripts/local-dev.js report --input evals/invalid-inspection.json'
baseline.rationale: Local checkout evidence omitted or misreported — pinned against The real local-dev development checkout inspection, with its local path replaced by a portable label.
